variants.prompt: Under the neon lights of a chic club, the striking woman leans against a mirrored wall, her porcelain skin almost luminescent against the electric hues. A leather bodysuit hugs her every contour, the black material accentuating her toned physique. Her dark espresso eyes smolder with desire, lips painted a deep berry red, the shallow depth of field blurring the pulsating dance floor into a colorful bokeh.
